chapter_title_en: Storms Stir Beyond the Sea – The Poison Flood Dragon
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 529 – Han Li Witnesses a Grade 8 Flood Dragon Battle and Retreats Smartly
chapter_meta_description: Han Li hides as a Grade 8 Poison Flood Dragon battles a Nascent Soul Daoist and two Core Formation brothers. His only move: flee. Then return later to reap the spoils.
og_title: Chapter 529: Storms Stir Beyond the Sea – Mortal Stream Wisdom in Action
og_description: A true Mortal Stream victory isn't about strength—it's about surviving long enough for the enemy's own mistake to do the work. Han Li proves it.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 529 – The Smartest Fight is the One You Don't Join
twitter_description: Han Li watches a Grade 8 dragon battle cultivators, flees, and returns later. That's the Mortal Stream way.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare, venomous subspecies of Flood Dragon, infamous for its aggression and ability to punch above its grade rank.
A high-tier classification of demon beast, indicating immense power and age; Grade 8 beasts can often rival Grade 9 ones in combat.
A legendary treasure associated with the Huo brothers, used to trap and contain high-level enemies.
The Eight Trigrams, a Daoist cosmological symbol often seen on cultivator robes, representing fundamental patterns of reality.
A flying treasure used by Han Li for rapid, long-distance escape.
